ValidationRule.description: If Status is not Used, used date and used on should not be changed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISPICKVAL( Coupon_Status__c, "Used" )) && ( ISCHANGED( Coupon_Used_Date__c ) || ISCHANGED( Coupon_Used_On__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Coupon Used Date and Coupon Used On can only be set when setting the Coupon Status to Used
